meaning: the entity has the catalog item it succeeds, named at a version: a reader takes that item's components at that version, each replaced whole by the entity's own component of the same name
_notes: `owner` is `agent-studio`, who answers for this shape today; the registry moves ownership freely (world-proto server/DESIGN.md section 7). Lead decided, say if not.

The schema is open to fields it does not name, as every registry schema is (world-proto SPEC section 9's lenient reading), so a misspelt optional field passes WPS and is carried unread. Lead decided, say if not.

A reference field takes a declared or derived identity, bare or with any pin, as the core's references do (without their `local_ref`); the pin rule, enforced on world-proto master since c384e59, refuses a wrong pin in its own sentence, and `refs[].pin` says which pin each field takes. Lead decided, say if not.
`asserts` is `has`: a component that carries a reference asserts having (world-proto SPEC section 2). Lead decided, say if not.
`expects: robot_class` follows the override spec's readiness check: `of` names an entity carrying `robot_class`, at a version (07-scenario.md section 3.7).
Not in the schema, the API's readiness check: the override replaces at least one component of the item, and `of` never names another override.

schema.title: successor
schema.description: the entity has the catalog item it succeeds, named at a version: a reader takes that item's components at that version, each replaced whole by the entity's own component of the same name
schema.$comment: Written for world-proto's registry from Agent Studio's 07-scenario.md section 3.7 (notes/agent-studio-2026-10-17/design/specs/07-scenario.md). Open to fields a newer writer adds (SPEC section 9).

of.description: The catalog item succeeded, pinned at a changeset (a tag once tags land, stored as written); never `@head` or a branch, which the pin rule refuses across units.

reference.title: reference
reference.description: Another entity, by identity: a declared UUID or a derivation address, bare or with a pin. Which pin a field takes is the pin rule's to enforce: within the referrer's unit bare or `@head`, across units a changeset (a tag once tags land).

entity_id.title: entity id
entity_id.description: A declared entity's UUID or a derived entity's address, either arm (SPEC section 3).
